summary: Quiet Carinya Street kerb backing onto bush, homes across a narrow road.
reasons: East side backs onto dense bush

drivers.seclusion: East side is dense bush; nearest houses are 26 m or more away on the far side of the road, though one is 18 m at the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, reachable by 2WD. Road is narrow with trees to the edge on the east, so room to pull fully out of the lane is limited.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential dead-end style street; arterial road lies beyond the bush to the east.
drivers.convention: No parked cars or markings seen on this stretch, so no parking convention.

flags: Slight slope: about 3% over best section
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the east side; shaded for most of the day, more in the morning.

best_section.where: East kerb of Carinya Street, bush on the east side, south of the first bend
